title: Hallucination Direction Geometry: Layer-Wise Emergence of Hallucination Representations

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: if early-layer probes can predict hallucination, this enables generation-time intervention rather than post-hoc detection. Directly actionable for deployed systems.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires training concept probes at every layer and measuring accuracy per layer. Extraction at all layers is more compute-intensive but feasible on medium compute for a single model. The methodology is a straightforward extension of standard probing.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused: train probes at each layer, plot accuracy vs. layer depth, determine if early layers suffice. Single experiment with a clear visualization deliverable. Completable in 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
